info.title: Torii Project/Object/Version API
info.description: SPEC-0001 accepted under delegated delivery mandate; wire format 0.2.0, semantics revision 0.3. Not all routes are implemented. See ../access-and-api.md for normative semantics, error ordering and conditional CSRF. Authentication alternatives are exclusive. Common error response vocabulary includes infrastructure-level errors; applicability is defined in the prose contract.

get.summary: Start OIDC Code + PKCE S256 login
Consume one-time login flow; redirect to /projects or fixed error screen
Current principal; CSRF token null for Bearer

post.summary: Invalidate local session; cookie and CSRF required
Create project and initial owner atomically

get.summary: Owner-only paginated membership list; use access-policy resource for edits and ETag

post.summary: Create metadata and draft revision 1 atomically

patch.summary: Rename/description change independent of definition digest

get.summary: Read draft and its revision ETag

post.summary: Finalize draft; existing identical digest gives 200, new version 201

get.summary: Read immutable version; no write endpoint

post.summary: Owner-only active to archived, object ETag required

get.summary: Owner-only complete access policy, at most 100 members, strong ACL ETag

put.summary: Owner-only atomic replacement of access policy; at least one active owner; no duplicate principals

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Signed opaque cursor, TTL 15 min, actor/scope/filter-bound; invalid returns generic 400.

Query.name: q
Query.description: Literal case-insensitive name substring; authorization precedes filtering.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: One strong resource-specific ETag. Missing 428, malformed 400, stale 412.

Idempotency.name: Idempotency-Key
Idempotency.description: UUIDv4, scoped to actor/operation/project (organization for project creation), TTL 24 h.

Csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
Csrf.description: REQUIRED for cookie-authenticated mutations, not for Bearer without cookie; matching Origin is also required.

Problem.description: Problem Details; no sensitive values. See access-and-api.md for semantics and authorization ordering.

Retry-After.description: Required for 429 and retryable 503; omitted otherwise.
